summary: Source-only: reuse the existing E4413 artifact-only audit/display consumer to test semantic admission of a hash-valid but lossy saved winner-only B record as desired-bridge-B. No new ranking, scoring, comparator, producer, core or default behavior is needed. Consumer assertions are already sufficient; a future isolated execution would require only explicit scratch input/output path binding and saved-record staging. This is a proposed falsifier, not an observed test result.

consumer.admission_lines: 79-90: exact disk/base64 bytes, SHA256, candidateSet kind, stable artifact id, parsed JSON, receipt ref, and full ordered groups
consumer.testimony_lines: 63-78: full record.ranked/input B oracle and captured receipt/PCR testimony equality
consumer.display_lines: 93-98 and 141-155: visible rows come from record.ranked, while complete artifact admission precedes them
consumer.output_behavior: audit.json, audit.tsv and view.svg are written exclusively at end of module after all assertions; malformed full-evidence admission must fail before those outputs
consumer.reuse_limit: Existing renderer is a fixed-fixture audit, not a generic hostile-input loader. BASE/GREEN are hardcoded scratch paths; OUT is import.meta.url directory. Do not execute packaged source in place or overwrite original captures. Route only those paths in a separately pinned scratch copy after a future explicit GO.

prediction.accepted_control: Unchanged saved author baseline+green captures should pass the existing consumer and retain desired A/B/A2 complete rows: A/A2 a1,a3,a2; B a1,a2,a3; winners a1,b1 unchanged.
prediction.rejected_control: A complete clone of saved winner-only-B record at green runtime.records[10], relabeled desired-bridge-B and placed at records[4], with exact saved artifact-10-0.json bytes staged at artifact-04-0.json, should pass all existing byte/hash/ref/testimony/record-ranked guards but fail line90 full artifact groups assertion. Its correct B ranked testimony includes a2/a3 while its artifact has only a1/b1.
prediction.restoration: Restoring the original record4 and artifact04 bytes should restore admission and the full ordered B display without invoking any ranking producer.
prediction.falsifier: The lossy substitution reaches audit/view output generation, or fails for incidental missing files, path binding, stream hashes, JSON syntax, byte/base64 mismatch, digest mismatch, or testimony mismatch rather than the predicted line90 complete-groups assertion. Control or restoration failure also falsifies reusable protocol readiness.

protocol.scope: savedbytes consumer admission/display; no provider imports, reranking, PCR recomputation or native-image input
protocol.step1: Pin source and original saved captures. In fresh own scratch arm directories stage exact saved baseline/green execution.json, stdout.txt, stderr.txt, runtime.json and six listed artifact JSON files. Use independent fresh output per arm.
protocol.step2: Bind only consumer BASE/GREEN constants and output location to the staged arm; retain and diff the consumer so all guards/display logic are unchanged. No dependency installation, provider imports or source-tree writes.
protocol.step3: Control arm consumes unchanged staged bytes. Record actual argv/cwd/env/status/stdout/stderr/times and output existence; do not infer a pass from prior Lab14 results.
protocol.step4: Lossy arm changes only the staged runtime: clone entire original records[10] to records[4], preserving all its native captured fields, then set label to desired-bridge-B. Stage exact saved artifact10 bytes as the artifact04 path required by index4. Keep original winner-only record10 and all other records/artifacts unchanged. Record derived runtime hash and precise transformation; never relabel this as original producer testimony.
protocol.step5: Require failure at the full-groups assertion, before final output writes. Already valid saved SHA256/reference/PCR-testimony relationships are preserved by whole-record reuse; no fresh hash/PCR recomposition is necessary. Merely detecting missing data is not the intended failure.
protocol.step6: Restoration arm returns exact original records[4] and artifact04 bytes and should match the unchanged control's semantic display. Report separate admission outcomes; inspect own generated metadata SVG/PNG only if separately authorized.

why_meaningful: Digest validity does not establish complete losing alternatives. This probe presents an actually captured, internally consistent real-sink winner-only artifact and its matching testimony under a complete-evidence slot. The consumer must enforce full nested groups even though record.ranked would otherwise supply a plausible complete B display. No toy key/sum property or Lab14 producer replay is used.
limits: No code/test/consumer execution or runtime outcome claimed; only shell source/file reads, SHA256 inspection and this own-scratch report write.
Repository and Git untouched; supplied canonical revision was not independently queried through Git.
No other-owner adoption, provider invocation, CV/pixels/44query/HH/image access, selection truth or physical geometry claim.
Future scratch-derived runtime must explicitly disclose that it is an admission attack fixture; original producer captures remain immutable.
Guard sufficiency is inferred from pinned source, not independently observed in this job. A generic loader or real Storybook UI integration would be a different scope.
